name: week
title: Engagement week
subtitle: Internal review, fictional data until replaced

sections.title: Commitments due
sections.sql: select project,stakeholder,commitment,owner,due_on,overdue from commitment_register where status='open' order by due_on

sections.title: Open issues
sections.sql: select project,stakeholder,issue,severity,open_promises from issue_register where status='open' order by due_on

sections.title: Engagement gaps
sections.sql: select project,stakeholder,owner,last_contact from engagement_coverage where influence>=4 and (last_contact is null or last_contact<current_date-30) order by stakeholder

sections.title: Collection and retention prompts
sections.sql: select * from privacy_checks order by stakeholder,rule
sections.note: These checks prompt a human review. They do not establish legal compliance.
